about: Real 2026/27 entries scored by FPL, and in-play cases constructed from them. See contracts/conformance/README.md.

cases.name: in-play-a-starter-yet-to-play
cases.why: 399 has not kicked off: he keeps his place, so 15 stays on the bench (FPL's 65 less 15's 3).

cases.name: in-play-a-captain-yet-to-kick-off
cases.why: 411 has not kicked off: the armband stays with him and his 0 so far, not with vice 165.

cases.name: in-play-a-captain-playing
cases.why: 411 is mid-match on 8: his points so far are multiplied by the armband.

cases.name: in-play-a-blank-starter-substituted-at-once
cases.why: 399's club has no fixture: he is substituted while 124 is still playing.

cases.name: in-play-a-double-gameweek-half-played
cases.why: 399 missed his first fixture and has a second to come, so he stays; captain 411 has 13 from his first and the armband doubles them.

cases.name: in-play-a-substitute-yet-to-play-holds-the-place
cases.why: 399 did not play; first substitute 15 has not kicked off and could come on, so nobody comes on yet: if 15 plays he is FPL's choice, so 346, who played, waits (FPL's 65 less 15's 3).

cases.name: in-play-a-substitute-who-did-not-play-is-passed-over
cases.why: 399 did not play and first substitute 15's gameweek is over without a minute, so 346, who played, comes on while 244 is still playing (FPL's 65 less 15's 3, plus 346's 9).

cases.name: in-play-a-substitute-yet-to-play-who-could-not-come-on
cases.why: Defender 152 did not play in a three-defender XI; first substitute 124, a midfielder, has not kicked off but could never replace him, so he holds nothing and 259 comes on.

cases.name: in-play-a-reserve-goalkeeper-yet-to-play
cases.why: Goalkeeper 301 did not play; reserve 529 has not kicked off, so he holds the place and nobody replaces 301 yet; 305 still comes on for 533 (FPL's 56 less 529's 1).

cases.name: in-play-a-double-gameweek-unfinished-first
cases.why: As the half-played double gameweek with each player's fixture to come listed first: 399 is complete only when both are finished, whichever order they come in, so he stays.

cases.name: finished-gameweek-unchanged
cases.why: Every fixture finished: the in-play rules give FPL's own answer for the case it is from.
